final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS avg_patient_ana FROM patient_averages) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - o.avg_patient_ana FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE p.avg_ana > o.avg_patient_ana ORDER BY p.avg_ana - o.avg_patient_ana DESC LIMIT 10
